//: Development only. HostBaseAddress is where Yello.Host listens under both `dotnet run` and `aspire run` - Aspire honours the project's launch profile, so Yello.Host/Properties/launchSettings.json's http applicationUrl is the value here. There is no appsettings.json sibling: with no configured address the client falls back to its own origin, which is correct for a same-origin deployment. Story 1.10 owns deployment configuration. Note that a cross-origin call from this client to that address additionally needs CORS, which story 1.4 owns.
